name: Produce Flame

targets.description: Hurled flame: one creature or object within 60 feet, as a Magic action.

summary: A flame in your hand gives light; as a Magic action, hurl fire 60 feet for 1d8 Fire damage.
text: A flickering flame appears in your hand for the duration. It gives off no heat and ignites nothing, but it sheds Bright Light in a 20-foot radius and Dim Light for a further 20 feet. Casting the spell again ends it. Until the spell ends, you can take a Magic action to hurl fire at a creature or object within 60 feet of you: make a ranged spell attack, and on a hit the target takes 1d8 Fire damage. The damage becomes 2d8 at character level 5, 3d8 at level 11 and 4d8 at level 17.
